[Skip to main content](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/cVkNdnyT/life-insurance-relief#main-content) # Life Insurance Relief - SupportGoWhere Life Insurance Relief Share link Provides tax relief of up to $5,000 for individuals who paid annual insurance premiums on their own life insurance policies. SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS - Life Insurance Relief up to $5,000 [Apply now](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/login/selection) Expand all sections About this support - Tax relief for your life insurance premiums - If you are a married man, you may also claim the life insurance premium paid for your wife - The amount of relief is capped between the lower of: - Difference between $5,000 and your CPF contribution; or - Up to 7% of the insured value of your own / your wife's life, or the amount of insurance premiums paid Who is this for? To claim Life Insurance Relief, you must meet all the following conditions: - You have paid, and are claiming, for your own life insurance policy - Married men may also claim for premiums paid on their wife’s life insurance policy - The insurance company has an office or branch in Singapore - The Singapore office of the insurance company should perform similar activities as the overseas company where the life insurance policy was purchased - Your / your wife’s total CPF contributions for the following were less than $5,000 in the previous year: - Compulsory employee's CPF contribution - Compulsory MediSave or voluntary CPF contribution for self-employed individuals How to apply? If you were previously approved for this relief last year (and your circumstances have not changed), the amount will be pre-filled and automatically granted. Please refer to the process for first-time applicants below to update your claim if there are changes. | For e-Filing: | For paper filing: | | If this is your first time claiming this relief:
- Log in with your Singpass or [Singpass Foreign user Account (SFA)](https://www.iras.gov.sg/digital-services/others/singpass-foreign-user-account-(sfa)-for-foreign-individuals) at [myTax Portal](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/login/selection)

- Navigate to “Individuals” > “File Income Tax Return”

- Select “File” to File Income Tax Return

- Go to “4. Deductions, Tax Reliefs and Rebates”

- Select “Add New” > “Life Insurance”

- Fill in the relevant information and select “Update” | - For Form B1 & B, fill in the “Life Insurance Relief” section

- If claiming for the first time, provide details of the premiums paid in Appendix 2 | Where can I find help? [View more details](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/individual-income-tax/basics-of-individual-income-tax/tax-reliefs-rebates-and-deductions/tax-reliefs/life-insurance-relief) * * * IRAS hotline: [1800-356-8300](tel:1800-356-8300) Airtime charges apply for mobile calls to 1800 service lines. Calls are free of charge only if made from regular land lines in Singapore. * * * [Submit an enquiry](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us/individual-income-tax) * * * [Visit your nearest branch](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us/locate-us) Scheme last updated 28 Sep 2025 Try our AI search
